principle.name: Preserve first
principle.description: Keep existing architecture, scripts, aliases, config, and validation flows unless the user explicitly requests a change.

principle.name: Smallest correct change
principle.description: Prefer surgical edits over rewrites. Decompose larger work into small steps that are independently testable.

principle.name: Reuse before create
principle.description: Search for existing conventions, files, and abstractions before introducing new ones.

convention.rule: Preserve the stronger rule when multiple governance sources overlap.
Respect CLEAN boundaries and keep domain, app, ui, infrastructure, and platform concerns separated.
Prefer existing pnpm scripts and validation gates instead of ad hoc command chains.
Preserve path aliases and do not replace them with deep relative imports.

category.name: before_editing
category.item: Read the minimum governance needed for the task.
Identify the affected layer and the likely files.
Check for existing code or mode guidance that can be reused.

category.name: during_editing
category.item: Avoid adding duplicate rules or parallel workflows.

category.name: before_completion
category.item: Run the narrowest meaningful validation available.
Confirm no scripts, aliases, or config were removed.
Confirm the mode files remain synchronized.
